tool_calls.literal:
/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.stack_frames[0], (.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{sum["'$1]+=$2; if($2>0){bad[$1]+=$2; bp[$1]++}else{good[$1]+=-$2; gp[$1]++}} END{for(k in sum) printf "%s'"\\tbad=%d\\tgood=%d\\tnet=%+d\\n\",k,bad[k],good[k],sum[k]}' | sort -t= -k4,4nr | head -30
jq -r '[.stack_frames[2], (.value|tostring)]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{sum["'$1]+=$2; if($2>0)bad[$1]+=$2;else good[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in sum) printf "%s'"\\tbad=%d\\tgood=%d\\tnet=%+d\\n\",k,bad[k],good[k],sum[k]}' | sort -t= -k4,4nr | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.value, .labels.source_session[0], .stack_frames[2], .stack_frames[3]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0){b+=$1;bs[$2]=1}else{g+=-$1;gs[$2]=1}; net+=$1} END{for(x in bs) nb++; for(x in gs) ng++; printf "bad_repeated=%d good_repeated=%d net=%+d bad_sessions=%d good_sessions=%d'"\\n\",b,g,net,nb,ng}'
jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[0]==\"result:repeated\") | [.stack_frames[2], .value] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$2>0)b[$1]+=$2;else g[$1]+=-$2} END{for(k in b) printf "%s'"\\tbad=%d\\tgood=%d\\tnet=%+d\\n\",k,b[k],g[k],b[k]-g[k]}' | sort -k4,4nr
jq -r '[.value, .labels.source_session[0]] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0){b+=$1;bs[$2]=1}else{g+=-$1;gs[$2]=1}} END{for(x in bs)nb++;for(x in gs)ng++;printf "all_bad=%d all_good=%d bad_sessions=%d good_sessions=%d'"\\n\",b,g,nb,ng}'"
